header.title: How to Safely Install a Gas Dryer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely install a gas dryer, covering gas and electrical connections, vent inspection, and leak testing.

steps.description: This step instructs the user to turn off the gas and electricity supply before starting any repairs or installations.
actions: Turn off the main gas supply at the meter.
Remove the cap on the gas pipe (if present).
Hold the pipe to prevent it from turning while removing the shutoff valve (if necessary).
Turn off the power at the breaker box.
steps.part: Gas meter, Gas pipe, Shutoff valve, Breaker box

steps.description: Install the gas connection parts for the gas dryer, referring to the dryer's installation kit or contacting a gas provider if unsure.
actions: Refer to the gas dryer installation kit for instructions.
Contact your gas provider if unsure about the installation.

steps.description: Inspect the dryer vent hole to ensure it matches the vent hole in the home.
actions: Check vent hole on gas dryer
Ensure vent hole matches home vent hole
Cut a new dryer vent hole (if necessary)

steps.description: Clean the floor where the gas dryer will be installed and its surrounding area.
actions: Wash the floor
Dry the floor
Inspect the vent hole
Clean up debris

steps.description: Apply pipe dope to the threads and then screw the stainless steel connector onto the pipe.
actions: Put pipe dope on the threads
Take your stainless steel connector
Screw it to the pipe

steps.description: Check the newly installed gas connections for leaks using a soapy water solution.
actions: Mix 50 percent water with 50 percent liquid dish soap.
Put the solution on the gas connections.
Turn on the gas.
Observe for bubbles.
Tighten connections if bubbles are present.
Test again until the leak is gone.

steps.description: Fasten the vent housing to the duct and secure it with a hose clamp.
actions: Fasten the vent housing to the duct
Place your hose clamp on
Tighten

steps.description: Connect the vent hose, position the dryer, and ensure proper clearance from the wall.
actions: Plug in the gas dryer
Attach the loose end of the vent hose
Push the dryer back into place
Keep the dryer at least three inches off the wall for circulation
Check local codes and regulations regarding dryer elevation

steps.description: The final step involves turning on the gas and breaker, then testing the new gas dryer.
actions: Turn the gas on
Turn the breaker back on
Test drive your new gas dryer
